entities.summary: La Nueva España is a daily newspaper in Spain. Published in Oviedo, it serves Asturias. The publisher of the paper is Editoral Prensa Asturiana. It is published in tabloid format. The paper has an independent political stance. La Nueva España is a newspaper in Oviedo, established in 1936. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
